# Official source fixture

`cbc-selected-rates.xls` is the unmodified CBC Taiwan Selected Interest Rates workbook
retrieved 2026-10-06 from https://www.cbc.gov.tw/public/data/Ebanking/EINTEREST-N.xls.
SHA-256: 71e0377d1ea336fb89292295b04e0abae3662a6f614d2214d074a9e413e000ce.
Publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan).
Source: https://www.cbc.gov.tw/en/cp-511-1876-0EF53-2.html.
Reuse: Open Government Data License Taiwan 1.0, with attribution;
https://www.cbc.gov.tw/en/cp-958-40419-F8209-2.html.
The fixture tests original BIFF layout, period labels and column identity; it is
not a current production dataset. Other source samples in tests are synthetic.
